known: Regional forcing/field scores and published stationary hydraulic examples are exposed. No coupled finite-groundwater outputs inspected. Local Nile hydraulic/depth/storage/phenology parameters remain unqualified.
scope: Implement a conservative finite pond-to-aquifer-to-soil budget using the unchanged river/soil field operator, with supplied hydraulic permissions. Synthetic component controls only; no new Earth field, crop-yield, population or default scores.
state: Three existing soil stocks, pond and a fifth accessible aquifer stock, all mm per field above fixed inaccessible floors. Explicit nonnegative fixed aquifer capacity per field; start empty unless an explicitly accounted initial state is supplied. Periodic replay carries all five stocks with <=1e-6mm each and max50cycles, nonconvergence explicit.
contract: Source volumes m3/step, rain mm/step, field area m2 and actual dt in(0,1]days remain as existing. Caller supplies nonnegative hydraulic upper-permission mm/day, aquifer capacity mm, recharge rate mm/day and boolean recharge mask; no local rate/depth inferred. Inputs must reject missing/nonfinite values. The stationary hydraulic component does not grant water or become a local pressure/depth rule automatically.
operator: At stepstart, debit explicit aquifer external loss min(stock,loss_rate*dt), default loss0 is a declared closed-reservoir scenario. Upward transfer=min(supplied_permission*dt,aquifer_stock,soil_total_deficit). Fill deep available, then surface below-WP evaporable, then top available pools, paying every increment once; roots still cannot extract the below-WP stock. Next recharge ONLY from the previous pond stock, only where recharge_mask AND pond_permission are true: min(previous_pond,remaining_aquifer_room,recharge_rate*dt,infiltration_rate*dt). Debit that pond, credit aquifer, and subtract the recharge from the same step's infiltration allowance. Invoke the unchanged one-step river/soil/pond operator using modified stocks and remaining infiltration rate. Replenishing pond room requires the same finite river withdrawals/rain; conveyance losses, proportional/node/forest rationing and all existing ET rules remain. No reuse of same-step fresh delivery for aquifer recharge, no second upward transfer after recharge, no capture of already exported drainage/overflow/release and no instant downstream return flow.
accounting: Capillary transfer and pond recharge are internal, not external water sources/sinks. Aquifer loss is an explicit external sink. Whole field closure: previous five stocks + gross rain + useful river delivery = new five stocks + existing excluded rain/ET/drainage/overflow/pondrelease + aquifer loss. Joint river/area volume closure includes gross source, conveyance losses and terminal outlets once. Preserve flux/stock histories and explicit initial/final state.
controls: Zero capacity/permission/recharge/loss must reproduce every original field-year array exactly, including fractional steps and forest routing. Controls for no free empty-start uptake, paid recharge then later transfer, zero permission/full soil/empty stock caps, below-WP access, shared infiltration budget, closed pond mask, explicit losses, shape/unit errors, joint field/node balances and all-five-stock periodic convergence/nonconvergence. Independent scalar soil/pond/forest implementation extended with aquifer phase; all synthetic history cells and per-step/annual ledgers checked, fresh numeric replay. Keep all prior protected and capillary source/component numeric files unchanged.
synthetic: Use seeded small forest/field forcings and supplied illustrative capacities/rates for numerical controls only. Retain all cases; no regional calibration or fitted parameter. Include finite demonstration columns and zero-groundwater controls labelled synthetic. No nominal capacity/rate is adopted from the known Nile coverage deficit.
limits: This is an explicit operator split, not transient Richards/aquifer flow, an inferred water table, salinity, oxygen stress or observed recharge. Pond-only recharge with one-step lag is a bounded simplification; external drainage remains external. Soil/hydraulic retention and root-pressure definitions must be made consistent before field coupling of capillary permission. Local depth/storage/crop/drainage and forcing period/grid constraints remain open.
next: Qualify local consistent hydraulic/soil/root/water-table and recharge/drainage inputs; declare any field comparison with matched zero-groundwater and consistent-soil controls before outputs. Tigris/shared Earth-fantasy weather/river flow, independent regions and frozen harvest/whole-empire calibration remain open.
